notes: Print panel 400 x 1000 mm with 3 mm bleed (page 406 x 1006). Reference: faithful reproduction in source colours (drifted blues #1F4383 for header, bars, text and QR plate; token blue #0B3D8A in the badges; rich black as #000000), ArialMT (MOBIAN) outlined, the header edge shading rebuilt as vector gradient with the exact axis and curve of the PDF, QR modules from the clip path. Template: token colours only (#1A3580 all blues, #1D1D1B text), live Ubuntu text, every variable has data-variable (title-<bar>, day-N, hours-N, label-N, price-N, location-name, phone, terms-url), QR as placeholder group inside the navy plate (variable qr-target, example https://parkingyou.nl/nl/locaties/rotterdam/parking-maashaven/id=129). Bars run through the bleed; header band comp includes its own bleed. OPEN: terms URL. The print has www.parkingyou.nl/algemene-voorwaarden, the handbook (3.6) www.parkingyou.nl/nl/algemene-voorwaarden; the print value is kept as the variable value, the owner decides which one is correct. Positions: page mm minus 3 mm trim offset (the Phase 1 note 'text starts at 14.8 mm' is the page coordinate: 11.8 mm from the trim edge). The inverted QR (white on navy) may fail on some scanners; the sample decodes with zxing. Layout fact: bars 35.15 mm high, rows pitch 21.17 mm (1.2 x 17.64 mm).
